name: Deleting a reportee notifies their reporting manager
description:
Objective: Deleting a reportee notifies their reporting manager.
Preconditions: Open User lifecycle emails with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open User lifecycle emails.
2. Deleting a reportee notifies their reporting manager.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: When a reportee is deleted, the reporting manager must receive a REPORTEE_ACCOUNT_DELETED email in the configured app.
